title: Test-run artifact reads follow a redirected run-id child: keep directory handles through the read (TOCTOU)
outcome:
Found by the Codex reviewer of w-5c8b45a10439 R4 (delegation-869896d6, Medium 1, test_run_artifacts.rs:378), and ruled out of that item's frozen scope as a pre-existing path. artifact_parent drops its no-follow review-runs handle, the run-id child is canonicalized once, and TestRunDisk::read opens the request and results files by path. A concurrent redirect of the run-id child can therefore move the read, while revalidation checks only the parent path.
Fix direction: keep directory handles through the read (openat-style reads of the run child and its files, no-follow), so that first read and revalidation bind the same objects. Codex notes that the identity comparison in w-348bbf7f969b would not close this; the two are related.
acceptance: A behaviour test that fails before the fix redirects the run-id child between first read and revalidation and shows the read follows it. After the fix the read refuses, or stays bound to the original objects, with no wall-clock assertion.
Ordinary artifact reads, refusal codes and existing tests are unchanged.
The review pair has no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding, and the full gate passes on the exact landed input.
